notes:
Run 2026-10-25 06:31 to 09:05 UTC (date field is the task day, 2026-10-24) on a 4-vCPU / 15.6 GB shared cloud VM, so absolute timings are noisy; ratios are the useful signal. grit = main at the commit above (release build, grit 0.5.20, rustc 1.99.0); git = system git 2.43.0; no baseline release measured. No repo code was touched; unmodified grit, grit-bench and grit-http-server release binaries from main were used. The VM's global git config (core.fsmonitor, commit signing, URL rewrites) would skew git, so a minimal user.name/email config was used via GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 for the whole report. A first full pass without that isolation was discarded.
Harness: `grit-bench daily` aborts the whole run when any scenario fails, so it was run once per scenario (`--only <id>`, 143 executable ids, with grit-http-server on PATH). Per-scenario JSON was merged and converted to this schema (median_wall_ms -> median_ms, peak_rss_bytes -> max_rss_kb); headline=true/name are as flagged by grit-bench (the 17 required headline scenarios plus log/json-100, pull/rebase, push/force-with-lease, branch/list-json and branch/merged). `detail` objects (commands, prepare, correctness, phases) are carried unchanged. runs is 3 to 20 timed runs per tool after warmup (policy default). Fixtures: git.git, small, synth-10k, synth-100k and the other repos were generated by the harness; the repos block was recomputed from the cached fixtures (git.git is the current upstream clone, so its figures differ slightly from earlier v2.47.0 reports).
Noise re-runs: compared with daily/latest.json of 2026-10-23 (grit/git time ratio more than 20% worse, or peak-RSS ratio more than 30% worse), 16 scenarios were re-run 3 more times (4 invocations per tool; reported median_ms and max_rss_kb are the median of the four per-invocation medians/peaks, runs/samples_ms/min/max/stddev are over all samples; per-row `rerun` records the invocation count and the first-pass grit/git ratio): add/modified@big-blobs, add/update@synth-100k, clone/local@synth-10k, commit/paths@synth-10k, commit/small@synth-10k (mem), config/get@small, fetch/deepen@git-git, fetch/dry-run@git-git, fetch/incremental@git-git, fetch/noop@git-git (mem), fetch/one-branch@git-git, init/empty@small, log/all@git-git, pull/fast-forward@git-git, push/force-with-lease@git-git, push/incremental@git-git. Outcome: config/get@small (1.90x -> 1.34x) was noise; all others reproduced, so they are real changes against yesterday. Most notable: fetch/incremental, fetch/dry-run, fetch/one-branch, pull/fast-forward (and pull/check) are now about 6 to 7x slower than git (grit ~745 ms vs git ~110 ms; yesterday grit was 14 to 22 ms and 0.1x git) even though grit's own traced spans sum to only a few ms, so the time is outside the traced spans; per the scenario `detail.setup` these scenarios fetch from a local git http-backend HTTP server. push/incremental@git-git is now grit 1.76 s vs git 2.31 s (0.76x; yesterday grit was 7.6 ms vs git 1.64 s, which the 2026-10-23 report flagged as unverified). commit/small@synth-10k kept its time ratio (0.83x) but grit peak memory is 1.75x git (0.59x yesterday).
Failures (kept with grit=null and an error; neither tool has a number, and all are harness failures that reproduce on re-run, nothing was substituted): add/hunks@large-file and add/patch-file@large-file and revs/count-path@git-git (the git side of the timed run exits 128), add/lines@large-file and remote/rename@many-refs (scenario prepare command exits 1 before any timing), clone/shallow@git-git (correctness check cannot find its `remote.git-campaign-clone` directory for `git fsck`), push/refspec@git-git (grit push rejected as non-fast-forward in the harness correctness check). Fixed since yesterday: tag/contains@git-git and repack/full@git-git now complete (tag/contains grit 0.64 s vs git 6.4 s; repack/full grit 12.6 s vs git 4.8 s, 2.6x).
Other things worth a look: fsck/full@git-git grit peak RSS is 18.8x git at equal time; log/path@git-git is 6.5x git; reset/mixed@synth-10k 5.1x; revs/count-author@deep-history 3.5x time and 3.0x memory; log/stat-n50@git-git 3.4x time and 2.8x memory.
